Stance: Highly Contrarian (Repurposing antidiabetic agent for healthy longevity)

Epistemic Frontier Question: Why is acarbose lifespan extension in female mice only +5% when given alone, yet jumps to +34% when combined with rapamycin? What are the exact epigenetic chromatin modifications induced by systemic butyrate in human vascular endothelial cells?
